framework.name: Australia Essential Eight
framework.description: The Australian Signals Directorate (ASD) Essential Eight is a set of baseline mitigation strategies designed to protect organizations against cyber threats. Controls are organized by maturity level.

controls.title: Patch Applications
controls.description: An automated method of asset discovery is used at least fortnightly to support the detection of assets for subsequent vulnerability scanning activities.

controls.title: Patch Operating Systems
controls.description: An automated method of asset discovery is used at least fortnightly to support the detection of assets for subsequent vulnerability scanning activities.

controls.title: Multi-factor Authentication
controls.description: Multi-factor authentication is used to authenticate users to their organisation’s online services that process, store or communicate their organisation’s sensitive data.

controls.title: Restrict Administrative Privileges
controls.description: Requests for privileged access to systems, applications and data repositories are validated when first requested.

controls.title: Application Control
controls.description: Application control is implemented on workstations.

controls.title: Configure Microsoft Office Macros
controls.description: Microsoft Office macros are disabled for users that do not have a demonstrated business requirement.

controls.title: User Application Hardening
controls.description: Internet Explorer 11 is disabled or removed.

controls.title: Regular Backups
controls.description: Backups of data, applications and settings are performed and retained in accordance with business criticality and business continuity requirements.
